title: Email Accounts
subtitle: Manage native Postfix and Dovecot mailboxes. Use SMTP port 587 with STARTTLS for authenticated sending.

generatedPassword.title: Password for {{email}}
generatedPassword.saveNote: Save it now. It will not be shown again.

enable.notEnabled: Email hosting is not enabled for this domain yet.
enable.info: Enabling it adds MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records when possible.
enable.resourceWarning: The mail stack (Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd, webmail) serves the whole server and takes extra RAM and CPU. Weigh the current load before enabling it on a small server.
enable.infrastructureMissing: Email cannot be enabled: the mail services on this server are not running ({{services}}). Ask the server administrator to run servika-mail-setup.
enable.infrastructureMissingGeneric: Email cannot be enabled because the mail services on this server are not running. Ask the server administrator to run servika-mail-setup.
enable.deliveryStopped: Mail delivery has stopped on this server ({{services}} not running). Your mailboxes and messages are intact, but nothing is being delivered or sent. Ask the server administrator to run servika-mail-setup.

forwarders.title: Forwarders and Catch-All
forwarders.description: Forward incoming mail to one or more destination addresses without creating a mailbox. Catch-all forwards mail for undefined addresses on this domain.
forwarders.catchAll: Forward all undefined addresses on this domain

spam.title: Spam Filtering
spam.description: Rspamd scores every incoming message. Greylisting temporarily defers, the header threshold flags mail as spam, and the reject threshold refuses delivery.
spam.notInstalled: Rspamd is not installed on this server; settings are stored but not enforced.
spam.enable: Enable spam filtering for this domain

autoresponder.title: Automatic Reply
autoresponder.description: Send a vacation reply from a mailbox, at most once per interval to the same sender.

filters.title: Message Filters
filters.description: Sort incoming mail into folders, redirect it, or discard it with Sieve rules compiled per mailbox.

sendLimits.title: Send Limits
sendLimits.description: Cap outbound recipients per mailbox. Exceeding a limit suspends the account automatically to contain a compromised login. Use 0 for unlimited.
sendLimits.suspendedNote: Auto-suspended at {{time}}. Reactivate the mailbox above to clear it.

messages.enabled: Email hosting has been enabled for this domain. MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records were added to DNS when possible.
messages.spamApplied: The Rspamd spam policy has been validated and applied.
messages.autoresponderSaved: The autoresponder and its Sieve script have been applied.
messages.filterAdded: The mail filter has been compiled and enabled.
messages.sendLimitsSaved: The send limits have been saved.
messages.disabled: Email hosting has been turned off. Mailboxes and stored messages were kept.
messages.purged: Email hosting and every stored message have been deleted.

confirm.deleteMailbox: Delete the mailbox "{{email}}"? The Maildir will remain on disk, and only the account row will be removed.
confirm.disableMail: Turn off email hosting for {{domain}}? Incoming messages will no longer be delivered and nobody will be able to sign in. Mailboxes and stored messages are kept, so turning it back on restores them.

errors.addForwarderFailed: Could not add the mail forwarder
errors.deleteForwarderFailed: Could not delete the mail forwarder
errors.updateForwarderFailed: Could not update the mail forwarder
errors.applySpamFailed: Could not apply the spam settings
errors.addFilterFailed: Could not add the mail filter
errors.readSendLimitsFailed: Could not read the send limits
errors.saveSendLimitsFailed: Could not save the send limits
errors.disableFailed: Could not turn off email hosting

webmail.title: Webmail
webmail.description: Sign in with the full email address and its mailbox password.
webmail.copyUnavailable: The address could not be copied; copy it from the field by hand.

delivery.title: Delivery history
delivery.description: What actually happened to messages sent from and to this domain. The queue above only lists what has not gone out yet.

disable.title: Turn off email hosting
disable.description: Stops delivery for this domain and blocks every mailbox sign-in. Nothing is deleted: mailboxes, forwarders and the stored messages all stay, and turning it back on restores them exactly as they were.

purge.title: Turn off and delete
purge.description: Removes email hosting for good. This cannot be undone.
purge.itemMailboxes: Every mailbox, forwarder, filter and autoresponder
purge.itemFiles: Every stored message on disk, and the space it uses
purge.itemDNS: DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) are kept, manage them on the DNS page
purge.confirmBody: This deletes every mailbox for {{domain}} and every message stored on disk. It cannot be undone.
purge.typeLabel: Type the domain name to confirm:

warning.mail_files_not_removed: Email hosting was deleted, but some message files could not be removed and still use disk space. Contact your administrator.
